task_completion.description: Open the initial Webots simulation file prosthetic_hand_test.wbt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Webots application window is visible showing a robotic hand and an egg object.

task_completion.description: Set the WorldInfo basicTimeStep to 16 or lower.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Scene Tree shows WorldInfo selected with basicTimeStep set to a value <= 16 in the field editor.

task_completion.description: Enable physics for the 'TEST_EGG' Solid and set mass to 0.05 kg.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Scene Tree shows the 'TEST_EGG' node with a Physics child node expanded, showing mass set to 0.05.

task_completion.description: Configure 'INDEX_TIP' as a TouchSensor with type 'force-3d' and resolution 0.001.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Scene Tree shows 'INDEX_TIP' node changed to or containing a TouchSensor with 'type' set to 'force-3d' and 'resolution' set to 0.001.

task_completion.description: Configure 'THUMB_TIP' as a TouchSensor with type 'force-3d' and resolution 0.001.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Scene Tree shows 'THUMB_TIP' node changed to or containing a TouchSensor with 'type' set to 'force-3d' and 'resolution' set to 0.001.

task_completion.description: Save the modified world to the specific path /home/ga/Desktop/prosthetic_grasp_test.wbt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save World As...' dialog box or the Webots title bar shows the file path /home/ga/Desktop/prosthetic_grasp_test.wbt.

integrity.description: The agent used the Webots GUI to modify node properties rather than just editing the text file via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Webots Scene Tree and Field Editor.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply rename an existing file but actively changed the parameters in the editor.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the values (16, 0.05, force-3d) being typed or selected in the Webots interface.

integrity.description: The agent saved the file to the Desktop as requested, not the original source directory.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file explorer or save dialog confirms the destination is /home/ga/Desktop/.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires specific values in the Webots Scene Tree: WorldInfo.basicTimeStep <= 16; TEST_EGG.physics.mass = 0.05; INDEX_TIP and THUMB_TIP must be TouchSensors with type 'force-3d' and resolution 0.001. The final file must be saved as /home/ga/Desktop/prosthetic_grasp_test.wbt.
